hits.draft_en:
Mustafa Suleyman shared Microsoft's Humanist AI Code of Conduct this week: a statement of what kind of AI we actually want in the world.

Great question for every maker too.

Before your next agent goes live, write one sentence: what should it never do on someone's behalf? Then put that in the instructions, not just the slide deck.
hits.video_tip: Quick-cut 15s: a whiteboard with 'NEVER' written at the top, marker adds one line, then cut to the same line pasted into Copilot Studio instructions.

So we built LifeVal, a new benchmark shaped by feedback from thousands of ChatGPT users on where they most want help from a personal assistant—from finding childcare to https://t.co/Q2EfGvHJpA
hits.draft_en:
OpenAI built LifeVal, a benchmark shaped by what thousands of ChatGPT users actually want help with. Think finding childcare, not solving olympiad math.

That's the benchmark your org needs too.

Before you ship a Copilot Studio agent, write down the five boring weekly tasks it should handle, and test those. Leaderboards don't file your expense reports.
hits.video_tip: Talking head 15s: hold up a fake 'leaderboard' then swap it for a sticky note that says 'Tuesday tasks'. Caption the last line.

hits.hook: "There isn't one model that's best at everything anymore": Auto in Copilot
hits.text:
There isn’t one model that’s best at everything anymore.

Choosing the right one for each task (without sacrificing quality or paying more than you need to) is a hard engineering problem.

That’s what we’re working on with Auto in Copilot. 

Today, more than 90% of Copilot https://t.co/QtrATtZxqV
hits.original:
There isn’t one model that’s best at everything anymore.

Choosing the right one for each task (without sacrificing quality or paying more than you need to) is a hard engineering problem.

That’s what we’re working on with Auto in Copilot. 

Today, more than 90% of Copilot https://t.co/QtrATtZxqV
hits.draft_en:
Hot take from the Copilot team: no single model wins at everything anymore.

That's why Auto in Copilot picks per task, balancing quality against cost.

Same lesson for Copilot Studio builders: stop asking 'which model is best?' and start asking 'best for which step?'

Your classifier and your summarizer don't need the same brain.
hits.video_tip: Vertical 20s: one agent flow on screen, each step lights up with a different model label. End card: 'Best for which step?'

hits.original: 🍪 Compare Models & Harnesses with Agent Bake Off!  Check out our latest video: https://t.co/qoOGQ7x4r0 https://t.co/gdGx6uAjbB
hits.draft_en:
VS Code is running an Agent Bake Off to compare models and harnesses side by side.

Steal that format for your own agents.

Same prompts, same data, two configurations, one scorecard. If you can't say why your Copilot Studio agent uses its current setup, you haven't baked it off yet.
hits.video_tip: Screen recording 20s: split screen of two agent runs on the same prompt, then a simple scorecard slides in with a winner ribbon.

drafts.text:
Hot take from the Copilot team: no single model wins at everything anymore.

That's why Auto in Copilot picks per task, balancing quality against cost.

Same lesson for Copilot Studio builders: stop asking 'which model is best?' and start asking 'best for which step?'

Your classifier and your summarizer don't need the same brain.
drafts.video_tip: Vertical 20s: one agent flow on screen, each step lights up with a different model label. End card: 'Best for which step?'

drafts.text:
OpenAI built LifeVal, a benchmark shaped by what thousands of ChatGPT users actually want help with. Think finding childcare, not solving olympiad math.

That's the benchmark your org needs too.

Before you ship a Copilot Studio agent, write down the five boring weekly tasks it should handle, and test those. Leaderboards don't file your expense reports.
drafts.video_tip: Talking head 15s: hold up a fake 'leaderboard' then swap it for a sticky note that says 'Tuesday tasks'. Caption the last line.

drafts.rides: @code Agent Bake Off (24,484 views) + @OpenAIDevs Agents API weekly ship (110,276 views)
drafts.text:
VS Code is running an Agent Bake Off to compare models and harnesses side by side.

Steal that format for your own agents.

Same prompts, same data, two configurations, one scorecard. If you can't say why your Copilot Studio agent uses its current setup, you haven't baked it off yet.
drafts.video_tip: Screen recording 20s: split screen of two agent runs on the same prompt, then a simple scorecard slides in with a winner ribbon.

drafts.rides: @mustafasuleyman Humanist AI Code of Conduct (6,985 views) + 1.39M link post
drafts.text:
Mustafa Suleyman shared Microsoft's Humanist AI Code of Conduct this week: a statement of what kind of AI we actually want in the world.

Great question for every maker too.

Before your next agent goes live, write one sentence: what should it never do on someone's behalf? Then put that in the instructions, not just the slide deck.
drafts.video_tip: Quick-cut 15s: a whiteboard with 'NEVER' written at the top, marker adds one line, then cut to the same line pasted into Copilot Studio instructions.
